name: Nagaradi Thailam (Oil)

sections.introduction: Nagaradi Thailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This formulation is known to treat problems related with ear.
sections.ingredients:
Nagara – Zingiber officinalis 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Lasuna – Garlic 
 Saindhava – Rock salt 
 Long Pepper – Piper longum 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Taila – Sesame oil 
 Arkapatra swarasa – Leaf juice extract of Calotropis procera 

 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients and add to Sesame oil and prepare the oil by oil paak method. 
 Usage 
 Take oil and pour oil drops in the ear. Do the procedure under doctor’s guidance.
sections.indications:
Ear ache 
 Tinnitus 
 Ailments above neck and of nasal area.
sections.contraindications:
No contraindications. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Nagaradi Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam, Taila Yoga Prakarana 
 Introduction 
 Nagaradi Thailam (Oil) is an ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from the mixture of herbs. This formulation is known to treat problems related with ear. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Nagara – Zingiber officinalis 
 Vasa – Adhatoda vasica 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Lasuna – Garlic 
 Saindhava – Rock salt 
 Long Pepper – Piper longum 
 Musta – Cyperus rotundus 
 Taila – Sesame oil 
 Arkapatra swarasa – Leaf juice extract of Calotropis procera 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Take all the ingredients and add to Sesame oil and prepare the oil by oil paak method. 
 Usage 
 Take oil and pour oil drops in the ear. Do the procedure under doctor’s guidance. 
 Indications 
 
 Ear ache 
 Tinnitus 
 Ailments above neck and of nasal area. 
 
 Contraindications 
 No contraindications. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
